description:
Top-level API module providing gen_tcp-compatible interface.
Thin wrapper dispatching to Listener and Socket GenServers.

defmodule GenTailscale do
  # Listener operations
  listen(port, opts) → {:ok, listener} | {:error, reason}
  accept(listener) → {:ok, socket} | {:error, reason}
  accept(listener, timeout) → {:ok, socket} | {:error, reason}

  # Socket operations (delegate to GenTailscale.Socket)
  send(socket, data)
  recv(socket, length)
  recv(socket, length, timeout)
  controlling_process(socket, pid)
  close(socket)
  shutdown(socket, how)

  # Info (work on both listeners and sockets)
  setopts(socket_or_listener, opts)
  getopts(socket_or_listener, opts)
  sockname(socket_or_listener)
  peername(socket)
  port(socket_or_listener)
  getstat(socket)
  getstat(socket, opts)
end

The socket/listener references should be opaque but pattern-matchable
for active-mode messages. Consider using a struct or tagged tuple.
